lines.en: : Hey, do you have a sec?
: Yeah. I have plenty of secs.
: Heh. Secs.
: Like sex.
: We can just ignore her.
I find myself talking to Otoha and Nodoka sometime in the middle of the class.
I tend to stop keeping track after the first hour because time is a meaningless construct and thinking about it for extended periods irritates me more than a stubborn hangnail.
: What do you need, Otoha?
: It’s not everyday that you of all people approach me.
: Yeah. I try to keep my distance because there are a few girls that glare daggers at me any time I come close.
: Not that I really want to anyway, but yeah.
: Well thank you for being so polite and informing me.
: If it’s any consolation, Sensei, I thrive off of the piercing gazes of our classmates.
: Come. Jump into my arms and show the world how we were meant to be.
: Shouldn’t you be the one jumping into my arms?
: Too predictable. I say we shake things up a bit.
: Can I continue now or do you two want to keep being secret siblings for a little while longer?
: Apologies, Otoha. Please proceed with inviting Sensei to your topless slumber party.
: I accept. I’ll mark it on my calendar.
: At least wait until after[school] if you’re going to be a creep.
: Hey, you’re the one who invited me.
: There is no topless sleepover. I wanted to ask if we needed like, permission slips or whatever for the beach thing.
: Oh. No, you should be fine.
: So...this[school] is just going to let a bunch of [teenage]girls stay overnight with a guy everyone is already suspicious of and not even make us get permission from our parents?
: No one is suspicious of me. I’m a totally normal guy with totally normal taste in women.
: Look. Just ask Makoto.
: Hm? I’m Makoto.
: Why am I being mentioned?
: Tell Otoha how normal I am.
: You? Normal?
: Next you’re going to be asking me to explain to her how Caligula was an entirely sane and widely appreciated emperor.
: That does not sound like something I would ever ask you to explain to anyone.
: Oh, Makoto. Loyal class representative and beautiful [young_girl].
: Would you like to hold hands and lovingly peer through the frames of each other’s glasses for the rest of the day?
: Hello Nodoka. No thank you.
: Rats.
: If there’s something you’re curious about that Sensei doesn't know how to answer, you can always ask me.
: I believe I overheard something about the beach?
: Oh, yeah. I was just wondering if we needed to like, get permission from our parents or anything.
: For any other class, yes. That is something you’d need.
: However, given that I am not only the class president but the head of the student council and an occasional assistant to the principal, I have my ways of averting typical requirements like that.
: So fear not, Otoha. I’m able to get all of you to the beach with just Sensei’s supervision alone.
: And that’s something you’re comfortable with?
: Wait. Yeah. Why am I just allowing this to happen?
: I’m supposed to be making sure the safety of the class is the top priority and-
: I, for one, feel there is no place safer than in the arms of a man twice my size.
: Come, Sensei. To the closet.
: The janitorial closets are off limits to staff members who aren’t part of the custodial roster.
: Can’t there be a momentary exception to that on account of all of the lives that have been lost in that department?
: Sure. As long as you sign out the needed materials.
: Do they keep condoms in there?
: AS IF YOU’D WILLINGLY USE ONE OF THOSE!
: Oh? What’s this?
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
: I...just meant that...
: I heard somewhere that...boys think they’re uncomfortable and...
: Oh, I forgot. I have a...meeting to attend.
: Hah...
: At least I can get around having to tell my mom about this.
: Forget your mom. I want to hear more about what’s going on with Sensei and his faithful assistant.
: I have no idea what you’re talking about.
: Makoto was probably just a little upset about the whole janitorial topic since she used to be dating one of the custodians.
: Is that who was bumping into us during our first time?
: Up until now, I had just assumed it was a mop.
: Nope. That’s just how wet-
: Okaaaaythanksforyourtimebyeeee.
: Yumi, you don’t think we’d be able to bring Chinami to the beach if we like, be super careful about it, do you?
: Fuck if I know. You’re the one who understands her health shit. I just know the outside world wants to kill her.
: Beach seems pretty fuckin’ outside to me.
: Chinami?
: Ah! I apologize!
: I inadvertently invited myself into a conversation I had no part in! How terribly rude of me!
: No no no! It’s totally fine. You can talk to us whenever you want!
: No you can’t.
: Chinami’s my little sister.
: She’s a 5,000 year old wizard.
: What a strange coincidence. My little sister also happens to be a 5,000 year old wizard.
: Wow! It’s so crazy that both of our sisters are 5,000 year old wizards!
: And um...I’m deeply sorry if it’s inappropriate for me, but... by health...you know what, is your bodyguard referring to your sister's disorder?
: Health “shit.” Stop actin’ like a fuckin’ princess and just say it.
: Bad words won’t fuckin’ kill you, you know.
: Yeah. She has to stay home most of the time and can’t really go anywhere without...protective gear.
: You mean like...a hazmat suit of sorts?
: Guess again, but with more fur.
: Chika?
: Sorry. I’m just gonna go call her really quick and see how she’s doing.
: Wait! No! Now I’m alone with the bully!
: The fuck did you just call me?
: Mother?! Sensei?!
: Anyone?!
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeey.
: I need to talk to you.
: Okay, but make it quick. I think Touka is being murdered.
: Actually, is it okay if we talk out in the hall?
: Yeah, I guess if we have to. But if Touka dies, I’m blaming it on you.
: Sensei! Wait! There’s a girl! A strong one!
: Makoto, watch the class while I’m-
: Oh, right. Makoto has a meeting.
: AAAAAHHHHH!!!
Rin pulls me out into the hallway and immediately slumps up against the window.
I recall her doing something before the last beach trip when-
: I’m gonna do it again.
: Do what again?
: You don’t mean-
: Ruin everything and then cry into your lap in my swimsuit.
: So...I just wanted to give you the heads up and stuff.
I’m not really sure what she expects me to say, but if she’s looking for encouragement or...positive reinforcement or something, she’d be better off with someone like Futaba.
Especially since I still have no idea how I’m even supposed to interpret my relationship with her.
: I take it this means you won’t be confessing to me?
: Thought so.
: Sensei...
: I want you to know that I don’t think kissing you was a mistake.
: You’re important to me and...even though I joke around about it sometimes, I really do see you as more than a friend.
: But...
: Look at Otoha, man...
: Look at her...and then at me...and tell me that you think you’d be a better match.
: You can’t, right?
: Just liking each other isn’t enough reason for us to be together.
: I want a girlfriend.
: I want someone to trade clothes and chapstick with.
: Someone who understands the way I feel a little better than some...much older guy.
: Even if he's a really cool older guy.
: Well...I certainly am very cool.
: Sensei...my feelings are already all stupid and immature.
: Don't make it sound like I'm going to have to choose between both of you, because...
: There's really only one way that choice would go right now.
: From the moment I first saw Otoha...I knew that I’d be doing this someday.
: Whether it be stalking her at the park or...doing it during some beach trip after a twist of fate lands her next to me in[school].
: It’s just...all so convenient.
: Like we’re supposed to be together or something.
: I just don’t want you getting ahead of yourself again. Or setting yourself up for disaster.
: Disaster is my middle name.
: Or, at least it would be if middle names were commonplace in Japan.
: I’m destined to follow my heart and jump the gun over and over again. And it’s not like I want to, but I’m going to.
: That’s just what being impulsive means.
: So...if things really do blow up in my face again-
: Don’t worry. My door will be-
: Wait. Do I even have a room this time? Or am I just staying with the dorm war winners the whole time?
: Oh.
: Huh.
: I mean...
: We could always probably find a shed or something.
: How many sheds do you think are just...near the beach?
: I don’t know, dude. There’s gotta be at least one, right?
Molly quietly and hesitantly slides open the door before joining the two of us in the hall.
My initial instinct is to leave the two of them alone to talk this out however normal [teenage]girls talk things out-
But I was the one who was invited out here.
And I don’t even know if Rin wants to talk to Molly right now or not.
So I hang myself in the limbo of either being the second or third wheel (Or I suppose the indeterminate numbered wheel for the immediate future) and wait to see how things unfold.
: Molly?
: Umm...
: Is your...mana...
: Are you okay?
: I’m fine. I just needed to talk to Sensei about something.
: But thank you for checking up on me.
: You just...looked kind of nervous...
: I am kind of nervous. But it’s not really something you need to get involved in.
: But...
: You know you...can involve me if-
: Really, don’t worry about it.
: I’m just being weird again. You know how I can be sometimes.
: Yeah...
: I...worry about you a lot...
: Like...
: A lot a lot...
: Thank you. Really. But hopefully you won’t have to worry for much longer.
: Yeah...
: Hopefully...
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
